person.title: Person
person.hiddenVia: You hide the paths through @{handle}: you stay friends and still see their posts.

friends.title: Friends
friends.empty: No friends yet. Friendships start in person, with an invite, or with a request to someone you are connected to.

requests.title: Friend requests
requests.incomingEmpty: No one is asking right now.

suggestions.title: People you may know
suggestions.mutual: {count, plural, one {# mutual friend} other {# mutual friends}}

blocks.title: Blocked people
blocks.help: Blocked people never see that you blocked them. Your posts and paths no longer reach them through you, and theirs no longer reach you.

confirm.unfriend: Unfriend @{handle}? Who invited whom stays visible.
confirm.block: Block @{handle}? This also unfriends them. They are not told.
confirm.hide_via: Hide the paths through @{handle}? You stay friends and still see their posts; people you reach only through them drop out of your feed. They are not told.

errors.friend_cap: You have reached 1,000 friends and open requests. Cancel a request or unfriend someone first.
errors.self_not_allowed: You cannot do that to yourself.

upgrade.title: Friend+ in person
upgrade.offer: Met @{handle} in person? Show them your code and let them hear the handshake sound to become friend+.
upgrade.hint: Ask @{handle} to open Join on their phone, signed in, choose “Scan a friend’s code” and scan this code.
